verdict.rationale: Oneleet ships its own MDM. Admins can confirm devices are managed, see each device's security posture and enforce security settings, with a one-click secure baseline for macOS and Windows. That covers the core of device compliance monitoring, but the evidence never names the specific checks in the story or shows per-employee tracking. Missing for 10: explicit disk-encryption, screen-lock and password-manager checks; per-employee compliance attribution or reporting; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, workstation compliance is tracked per employee — disk encryption, screen lock, password manager — via an agent or MDM integration

citations.quote: Admins can confirm that devices are managed, see each device’s security posture, enforce security settings, and take remote action when a device is lost, stolen, or being offboarded.
Oneleet offers a recommended secure baseline for macOS and Windows that can be applied in one click.
Oneleet MDM lets your team manage company-owned devices from the same dashboard as the rest of your security and compliance program.
Macs enroll through Apple's Mobile Device Management framework, either manually or zero-touch through Automated Device Enrollment
